lines.speaker: control
lines.text: Two hundred megawatts. Okonkwo has requested the brief. Actual has approved it.

lines.speaker: okonkwo
lines.text: I finished the order. All of it, not the operative clauses. I want to say it once before the shooting starts because I will not want to say it afterwards.

lines.speaker: vasquez
lines.text: Go.

lines.speaker: okonkwo
lines.text: The Ordinal were not losing. Sixty-one anchors, full capacity, no casualties in the record. They had the network and they had the power and they had time.

lines.speaker: okonkwo
lines.text: They calculated that the only way to contain it was to hold every anchor powered, permanently, with nobody leaving. So they did that. Until there was nobody left to do it.

lines.speaker: vasquez
lines.text: They chose it.

lines.speaker: okonkwo
lines.text: It's an arithmetic document, Vasquez. There isn't a sentence of grief in it. They worked out what holding cost and they paid it in order.
lines.beat: the act's central reveal, delivered as a filing summary

lines.speaker: control
lines.text: Contact.

lines.speaker: vasquez
lines.text: Sixty-one anchors.

lines.speaker: okonkwo
lines.text: Sixty-one. I know what you're going to say and I would rather you didn't yet.

lines.speaker: control
lines.text: Field lead, your capacity trend is on Actual's board and they are asking whether the reactor is faulty.

lines.speaker: okonkwo
lines.text: Tell them the reactor is in excellent condition and something is drinking out of it.

lines.speaker: vasquez
lines.text: How long could they hold one? With everything working.

lines.speaker: okonkwo
lines.text: Indefinitely. That was the point. It's us who have a clock.

lines.speaker: okonkwo
lines.text: The ceiling moved again. This is what the order is about — it isn't a war, it's an overdraft.

lines.speaker: control
lines.text: One through.

lines.speaker: vasquez
lines.text: Everything on the ring.

lines.speaker: control
lines.text: Anchor is held.

lines.speaker: vasquez
lines.text: Okonkwo. File the full translation to Actual. Every clause.

lines.speaker: okonkwo
lines.text: They'll classify it.

lines.speaker: vasquez
lines.text: File it anyway. I want it to exist somewhere that isn't your head.
